title: Pure Red-Eyes
summary: Red-Eyes cards with Max Metalmorph and generic staples. The Black Stone of Legend and Black Metal Dragon start the engine: the Stone summons a Red-Eyes from the Deck, and Black Metal Dragon equips to it and searches any Red-Eyes card when it leaves the field. Red-Eyes Soul and Black Meteor Dragon summon themselves and fetch Red-Eyes Fusion, and Darkness Metal Dragon brings Dragons back from the GY. Metal Claws Dragon, the newest Main Deck card, and Black Fullmetal Dragon both name Max Metalmorph, so it is the one outside card. Red-Eyes Black Dragon Exceed needs a Dark Time Wizard monster, and Red-Eyes Dark Dragoon needs Dark Magician, so neither is in the Extra Deck.

allow.Max Metalmorph: Red-Eyes Black Fullmetal Dragon and Red-Eyes Metal Claws Dragon both name it: it summons Fullmetal from the Deck.
allow.Striker Dragon: Link-1 Dragon that sends Normal Summoned Dragons (like Black Metal Dragon) to GY to trigger their search effects.

main: Red-Eyes Black Dragon
The Normal Monster everything names; fodder for Black Meteor Dragon and Return of the Red-Eyes.
The Black Stone of Legend
Tributes itself to summon a Level 7 or lower Red-Eyes from the Deck.
Black Metal Dragon
Equips to a Red-Eyes; sent from the field, searches a Red-Eyes card.
Red-Eyes Soul
Counts as Red-Eyes Black Dragon; summons a Red-Eyes from the Deck when they Special Summon, and burns.
Red-Eyes Black Meteor Dragon
Mills a Level 5+ Normal Monster to summon itself; from the GY, adds Red-Eyes Fusion.
Red-Eyes Darkness Metal Dragon
Banishes a Dragon to summon itself; revives a Dragon each turn.
Red-Eyes Metal Claws Dragon
Newest Main Deck card. Sends a Set card to summon itself; searches a Metalmorph Trap with Max Metalmorph out.
Red-Eyes Black Fullmetal Dragon
Max Metalmorph's target: negates a card on either turn and burns.
Red-Eyes Alternative Black Dragon
Tributes a Red-Eyes to summon itself; destroyed, revives one.
Gearfried the Red-Eyes Iron Knight
Destroys Black Metal Dragon equipped to it, triggering its search, and revives a Red-Eyes.
Red-Eyes Insight
Mills a Red-Eyes to search a Red-Eyes Spell/Trap.
Red-Eyes Fusion
Fusion Summons a Red-Eyes Fusion from the hand, Deck or field.
Cards of the Red Stone
Discards a Level 7 Red-Eyes to draw two and mill another.
Max Metalmorph
Tributes a Level 5+ Dragon to summon Red-Eyes Black Fullmetal Dragon.
Return of the Red-Eyes
Revives a Normal Monster each turn while you control a Red-Eyes.
extra: Level 7 Red-Eyes + Level 6 Dragon (Black Meteor Dragon): mills a Red-Eyes to burn.
Rank 7: burns for each of their activations and revives a Red-Eyes Normal.
Red-Eyes Black Dragon + a Warrior (Gearfried): negates targeting effects.
Darkness Metal, the Dragon of Dark Steel
Link-4 for same-Type, same-Attribute monsters: revives a monster from the GY or banishment.
Link-1: Link-1 Dragon that searches Boot Sector Launch on summon and pops a monster to recur a Rokket from GY.
